notes.title: Announce From Vector Games
notes.content:
Hello to all of our friends, gamers and supporters. We have a short announcement for you. 
First of all we fixed most of the reported bugs and update the game. We are still working on the rest to fix. 
After the first launch of Dark Raid we got lot's of messages, emails and comments from all over the internet. We appreciate your support and considerations about the game. Dark Raid is our first title but not least. We will continue to develop new games that we love to play and improve our skills throughout the process. 
We are ready to listen your new comments, solve your problems and add much more fun factor to our games. 
You can also use our forums for your bug reports, solutions, asking questions and giving some ideas http://www.forumsvectorgames.com/forum/index.php/BoardList/ 

Also we will open multiplayer games soon, you can share your suggestions about the multiplayer mode to http://www.forumsvectorgames.com/forum/index.php/Thread/22-Multiplayer-Ideas/
